summary: Exact is dutch business software company, founded in 1984. About 1,600 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 recent headline(s) about layoffs or reorganisation; 1 about funding; 1 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Exact is a Delft-based maker of cloud accounting and business software for small businesses, with 50 nationalities on staff and IND sponsor status.

culture.text: Founded in Delft in 1984; its software is used by more than 675,000 businesses and accounting firms.
Colleagues represent 50 different nationalities, and it works hybrid from offices across the Netherlands and from home.
It stresses learning, with a personal 'My Development Journey'; staff stories mention variety and good work-life balance.
Its 2 open jobs here are in software engineering and data, both in Delft.

open.text: Exact B.V. and Exact Cloud Development Benelux B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Both current postings need no Dutch, though they average 198 LinkedIn applicants each.
Parts of its careers site are only in Dutch, including the hiring process FAQ.

growth.text: Staff numbers were 1,700 in 2013, 1,550 in 2015 and 1,600 in 2016.
It is owned by investment firm Kohlberg Kravis Roberts (KKR).

worth_knowing.text: Its products now include AI-driven agents for accounting and ERP.
